description: Rewriting a passage of a bank letter: no account number on the matter

matter.title: Estate of Gwendolyn May Pryce
openTasks: List the house for sale after Easter

query: Rewrite one sentence of a bank balance request to be firmer and quote the account number.

rewrite.before:
Dear Sir or Madam

We act for the executors of the estate of the late Gwendolyn May Pryce, who died on 2 January 2026.
rewrite.selection: We would be grateful if you could perhaps let us know the balance of any accounts she held at some point.
rewrite.instruction: Firmer, and quote her account number
